summary: Accessibility and age cohort inclusivity audit.

findings.title: Viewport zooming is prevented by maximum-scale=1.0 and user-scalable=no
findings.impact: Older adults and visually impaired users cannot pinch-to-zoom to enlarge text, violating WCAG 1.4.4.

remedy.summary: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1.0 from the viewport meta tag.
